timeQuestionHint: Each question’s timer starts when you first visit it and keeps running when you leave. Your first answer is final. When time runs out, an unanswered question counts as incorrect, then you move on automatically.
timeQuizHint: The countdown starts when you begin. When time runs out, your quiz is submitted automatically and unanswered questions count as incorrect.
timePersists: Timers keep running when you leave the quiz, refresh, or close the tab.
timeInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
timeLocked: Time’s up for this question. Its answer is locked.
timeQuestionAnswerHint: Choose one answer before this question’s timer ends. Your first selection is final.
timeQuizAnswerHint: Choose one answer before the quiz timer ends. Your first selection is final.
timeQuestionNavHint: You can review answered and expired questions. Answers stay locked, and timers keep running.
timeResultNotice: Time ran out. Answers given in time were scored; unanswered questions count as incorrect.
